Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

translations.web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
translations.bsb: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
translations.kjv: ALEPH. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
translations.asv: ALEPH. Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
